name: Research and Test Cross-Domain Reframes
jtbd: When a decision is stuck in its familiar framing, find sourced mechanisms from other fields, test their structural fit and check proposed inferences against supporting and contradictory evidence so I can choose what deserves a deeper investigation.
runtime: MindrianOS host research broker plus local Python SME worker
limitations: The Scout does not execute network requests or verify host grants; it checks only query and source lineage.
External source coverage depends on enabled host providers and accessible source content.
Evidence statuses are reviewer conclusions with citations, not a truth guarantee.
MindrianOS retains filing and portfolio authority.
